paper_id: InspectCoder_ Dynamic Analysis-Enabled Self Repair through interactive LLM-Debugger Collaboration
title: InspectCoder: Dynamic Analysis-Enabled Self Repair through Interactive LLM-Debugger Collaboration
motivation: LLMs generate buggy code with complex logic errors; existing self-repair approaches miss runtime behaviors exposing bug root causes
problem_framing: LLM-based program repair via active dynamic analysis through interactive debugger control instead of static/log-based methods
key_insight: Dual-agent framework separates Program Inspector for debugger-driven root cause analysis from Patch Coder for grounded patch synthesis
method_signature: InspectWare middleware enables stateful LLM-debugger interaction with breakpoints, runtime inspection and reversible state modification
evaluation_criteria: Resolve rate on BigCodeBench-R/LiveCodeBench-R; #Fixes/Hour; #Fixes/Dollar; Pass Rate on full benchmarks
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: LLMs struggle with direct debugger interaction, experiencing frequent state corruption and error loops without middleware abstraction
evidence_for_taste: transforming LLM debugging paradigm from blind trial-and-error into systematic root cause diagnosis
missing the in-depth runtime behaviors that often expose bug root causes
marks a paradigm shift from passive consumption of post-hoc logs
LLMs lack training data on agentic debugger usage
thinking_moves: 把被动消费执行日志重新框定为主动LLM驱动的运行时分析
分离调试分析与补丁合成的职责边界
通过状态机抽象解决debugger状态管理复杂度
从一次性修复转向增量式调试验证
